messages:
Evan Brooks: Heads-up — Atlas (SMB) shows sharp drop in feature X usage after onboarding. Renewal in 26 days. Proposing a 'retention accelerator' to triage and attempt a save. Inputs?

Maya Singh: Details? Which flow is failing?

Rafael Gomez: Crash point seems to be the bulk ingest -> vectorize step. Their logs show many client-side retries and increased token spend. No server 5xx.

Sana Iqbal: Onboarding checklist: they skipped the "streaming vs batch" guide. PM said they defaulted to large batch uploads.

Evan Brooks: Suggested mini-play: 1) 20-min triage call with PM + engineer 2) quick enablement demo showing streaming and prefix-caching 3) temporary safety change (ingest throttling + small-file cap) 4) 72-hr watch + metric snapshot 5) renewal follow-up. Owner: @Maya.

Maya Singh: I'll run the demo and capture a one-pager summary for the renewals rep. Keep it super short.

Rafael Gomez: Safety config I can apply org-scoped: set ingest_concurrency=2 and max_upload_mb=6. Snippet for ops: {"org":"atlas","ingest_concurrency":"2","max_upload_mb":"6","enable_prefix_cache":"true"}. Will monitor token delta and retries.

Evan Brooks: Also add a "seat-sparing bridge" option if they want cost relief: temporary rate-limited reserved plan that lowers throughput but keeps audit logs & model pinning. Reversible in 1 API call.

Maya Singh: Outreach text for triage: "Hi {{name}}, we saw activity dip and can run a quick 20-min triage + one config change that often resolves this. Would tomorrow 11am PT work?"

Rafael Gomez: Pushed safety config to staging; smoke looks good. Ready to promote post-call.

cs-ops-bot: Ticket created CS-9432 for Atlas retention accelerator. Priority: medium. Assigned: Rafael Gomez.

Sana Iqbal: After call please paste: (1) pre/post WAU screenshot (2) whether they had prefix cache enabled (3) any doc feedback. We'll tag the play as 'retention-accelerator' in library.

Evan Brooks: Timeline: triage within 48 hours, promote safety config within 3 hours post-call if green, snapshot at 72 hrs, renewal note 7 days before renewal.

Maya Singh: I'll create the 1-pager and add the SDR copy into Gainsight after the snapshot.

Rafael Gomez: Will post prod verification logs after promotion.

Evan Brooks: Thanks team. If this moves metrics we formalize the play and build a canned workflow in CS toolkit. :handshake:
